comment: Every <service> a production manifest may declare. Each entry names the exact class, its foreground service type and the permissions that service brings; nothing else may declare a service. Services must not be exported. Add an entry only with a reviewed reason.

services.name: org.ramflux.feature.chat.MediaTransferService
services.reason: Keeps the process in the foreground with a visible notification while media imports and uploads the person started run inside the unlocked session; it opens nothing and stops when the queue is idle or the session closes (docs/media.md, Background transfer).
